messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert PD-90321 fired for service=redwood-edge-lb region=eu-west-1 — LB target healthy% dropped > 30% in 5m :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-90321 — triggered, urgent, auto-escalation in 5m if unacked. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-90321
maria_oncall: Acked PD-90321 — taking ownership. I'll update here. :raising_hand:
kevin_sre: seeing spike in 502/504s to inference hosts behind edge-lb-eu-w-1. Grafana: https://grafana.example/d/edge/lb-health (error rate up ~12% overall, 50% for a subset)
jonathan_net: I'm seeing TLS handshake errors in alb logs: "TLS_alert unknown_ca" and lots of "no route to host" to targets in AZ eu-west-1b. Possible cert rotation or backend node flapping.
maria_oncall: customer-impact: 3 customers reported degraded streaming, ~10% of requests failing. Support already triaged. @support-ops can you post customer list?
support-ops: customers: AcmeCorp, BrightPay, NotaAI — all in eu-west-1. CS is on calls with AcmeCorp now.
sre-lead: Maria, if it's TLS unknown_ca across several targets, could be that the edge-proxy cert chain was replaced with a wrong CA during last maintenance. When was last cert push?
eng-platform: we rotated edge-proxy certs 03:42 UTC as part of scheduled rotation, pushed via cert-manager job cm-rotate-2026-03-15. Rolling to 6 nodes, job shows completed, but logs show failures on node edge-proxy-3: "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority"
kevin_sre: That suggests the new cert chain isn't trusted by internal LB health checker or backend JVMs. Quick mitigation: mark problematic targets unhealthy at LB and drain. Rebalance weights to healthy nodes. I'll run weight-shift now.
jonathan_net: Doing weight shift: updating ALB target group tg-edge-eu-west-1 — setting weight edge-proxy-3 to 0, others incremented evenly. Command:
```
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:... --attributes Key=stickiness.enabled,Value=false
aws elbv2 register-targets --target-group-arn ... --targets Id=edge-proxy-1:443,Id=edge-proxy-2:443
```
kevin_sre: Done. Traffic shifted off edge-proxy-3. Health checks are still flapping on edge-proxy-3, others stabilized, error rate fell to ~2% in 2m.
maria_oncall: Good. Can we confirm if this was cert chain mis-issue and if auto-fallback to previous cert exists?
eng-platform: cert-manager attempted to apply chain X. We have a fallback key but the automated rollback didn't trigger because controller saw job success on majority. We'll push a hotfix: reapply previous cert chain to edge-proxy-3 only and restart the proxy process.
kevin_sre: Before restarting, let's confirm no pending in-flight KV cache evictions that would impact latency. Checking redis KV: all healthy.
jonathan_net: Reapplying old chain to edge-proxy-3 now:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart daemonset/edge-proxy --field-selector metadata.name=edge-proxy-3
kubectl -n infra set secret tls edge-proxy-cert --from-file=tls.crt=old-chain.crt --from-file=tls.key=old.key
```
(small pause)
eng-platform: old cert re-applied and process restarted on edge-proxy-3 — health checks passing now. TLS errors cleared from logs.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-90321: acknowledged by maria_oncall at 3876543215 — status=acknowledged
pagerduty-bot: PD-90321 escalated to Level 2 (kevin_sre) due to initial impact threshold.
kevin_sre: Running smoke tests against eu-west-1 endpoints:
```
curl -v https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.example/v1/health
> TLS handshake ok
> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```
maria_oncall: Customer impact update: errors down to near zero, AcmeCorp reports recovery. I'm leaving LB weight change and restart actions documented for postmortem.
sre-lead: Good mitigation. Let's keep incident open until 2 hours and run postmortem. Add remediation tasks: 1) make cert rollback automatic on single-node failure, 2) add extra validation in cert job to check root CA chain, 3) improve health checker to detect x509 mismatch earlier.
support-ops: Logged CS follow-ups and notified affected customers. No SLA violations yet but we'll keep monitoring.
eng-platform: Root cause probable: incorrect cert chain packaged in rotation artifact (cm-rotate-2026-03-15). Deploy team rolling back release of cm-rotate artifact and adding a unit test to validate chain with internal CA before apply.
jonathan_net: Monitoring now — alarms quieting. I'll keep ALB target weights at shifted state for 10m then gradually restore.
maria_oncall: thanks all. I'll update PD incident timeline and close after 1h of stable metrics. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PD-90321: status=resolved (manual) by maria_oncall at 3876543650
incident-bot: Thread closed — summary saved to /incident-logs/3876543210-summary.txt
